Image 1 is mood/layout reference ONLY: use its editorial phone mockups, warm cream paper, hand-drawn marks and torn-paper footer approach; DO NOT copy its app, words, author, handle, watermark or signature. Image 2 is the new Eagles 7–0 logo to reproduce faithfully. Other images are real browser captures of this actual game: put them into convincing front-facing graphite iPhone mockups with slim bezels and dynamic island. Every slide has small Eagles 7–0 mark/wordmark at top and footer “Believe Osawaru · App developer”. Use only the exact copy supplied, no extra claims or metrics. Different editorial composition for each slide but same system.

Exact subtitle: “Draft the legends. Manage Nigeria. Challenge a friend.” Exact stack line: “React Native · Expo · TypeScript · Node.js”. Tiny honest label: “Web + mobile source · AI-assisted build”.

brandPrompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a finished square 1024x1024 mobile game app icon for an independent Nigerian football game Eagles 7–0. A bold original geometric eagle silhouette with upward wings, subtly forming a numeral 7, wrapped around a small pentagonal football centre. Strong silhouette, friendly sporty curves, impeccable negative space. Single lime #D6F395 symbol on perfectly flat dark forest green #071E19 background, no gradients, no shadows, no mockup, no border, no text at all. Centre the symbol at 60% of canvas width with generous equal safe margins so circular app masks remain safe. Not an official national federation badge. Clean premium vector-like flat graphic, readable at tiny icon sizes.
